command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' "node=$NODE_NAME"
printf '%s\n' "identity=$(id -un)"
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' 'sudo_noninteractive=ok'; else printf '%s\n' 'sudo_noninteractive=unavailable'; fi
for c in mariadb mysql; do
  if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'client=%s path=%s\n' "$c" "$(command -v "$c")"; fi
done
for s in mariadb mysql; do
  v=$(systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$v" ]; then printf 'service=%s state=%s\n' "$s" "$v"; fi
done
auth_ok=0
for c in mariadb mysql; do
  if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n -H "$c" --protocol=socket -uroot -NBe "SELECT 'protected_socket_root'" >/tmp/galera_auth_probe.$$ 2>/tmp/galera_auth_err.$$; then
    printf 'auth_method=sudo_socket_root client=%s result=%s\n' "$c" "$(tr -d '\n' </tmp/galera_auth_probe.$$)"
    auth_ok=1
    break
  fi
done
if [ "$auth_ok" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'auth_method=none_verified'
  if sudo -n test -r /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/50-server.cnf; then printf '%s\n' 'protected_config=50-server.cnf readable'; sudo -n sed -n '/^[[:space:]]*\[mysqld\]/,/^[[:space:]]*\[/p' /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/50-server.cnf | sed -E 's/(password|pass|pwd)[[:space:]]*=.*/\1=<redacted>/I'; fi
  if [ -s /tmp/galera_auth_err.$$ ]; then sed -E 's/(password|pass|pwd)[^ ]*/<redacted>/Ig' /tmp/galera_auth_err.$$; fi
fi
rm -f /tmp/galera_auth_probe.$$ /tmp/galera_auth_err.$$
